contexts.text: By Man, and Son of Man, in the supreme sense, is meant the Lord; in the internal sense, wisdom and intelligence; hence everyone who is regenerate. Illustrated.
Called Son of Man, or Man, which is the same.
Hence, the Lord, being Himself the seed, called Himself the Son of Man, that is, the faith of the Church.
Those are called sons of man () who have been in faith in the Lord. ( = those who are in truths of faith. AC 1259:6.)
Which the sons of man were building () = the sons of the Church inventing.
For by the Son of Man is meant His Human essence, which when united was Divine... AC 1607:3. AC 1729.
See Son of God. AC 2159:2. AC 3704:2. TCR 92. Ath 132. CanonsNC 18. Redeemer. 5. 3.
The Lord often said that the Son of Man would suffer, but never the Son of God. Illustrated.
In all these passages, by Son of Man is meant the Lord as to truth Divine, or as to the Word in the internal sense.
It is rational truth, such as is with the Angels, consisting in appearances of truth, which is called the Son of Man, but before the glorification.
To hear the voice of the Son of Man = to have faith in the Lord's words, and to will them.

Then shall appear the sign of the Son of Man in heaven () = the appearing then of truth Divine; the Son of Man = the Lord as to truth Divine. ( = the truth Divine proceeding from the Lord. AC 8427:4.)
The time of the end of the old Church and the beginning of the New is meant by the coming of the Son of Man.
The truth which is from good is called... also son of man.
So shall the coming of the Son of Man be () = that they will not receive the Divine truth. The coming of the Son of Man is the Divine truth which will then be revealed.

When the Son of Man shall come in His glory () = when the Divine truth will appear in its light, which happens to every man when he dies; for he then comes into the light of Heaven, in which he can perceive what truth and good are, and thus his own quality. The Son of Man, in the internal sense, is the Lord as to Divine truth; thus the Divine truth which is from the Lord.
The Son of Man () = the Divine truth.
A son of man () = truth from good; in the supreme sense, the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord. References.
He that soweth the good seed is the Son of Man (). The Son of Man = the Lord as to the truths of the Church.
That they would do in like manner with truth Divine itself, is signified by, so shall the Son of Man also suffer of them (). The Son of Man = the Lord as to truth Divine.
The advent of the Lord and His presence in the Word, is meant by to see the Son of Man ().
The Son of Man = the Lord as to the Divine truth from His Divine Human. AC 9807:2, Illustrated.
To desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man () = one of the states of truth Divine which is genuine. AE 63:4.

When the Son of Man cometh shall he find faith upon the earth? () = when truth Divine shall be revealed out of Heaven it will not be believed. The Son of Man = the Lord as to truth Divine, or truth Divine proceeding from the Lord.
Henceforth ye shall see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of power, and coming upon the clouds of heaven (). The Son of Man = the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord. Further explained.

No one hath ascended into heaven, but He that descended out of heaven, the Son of Man who is in the heavens (). From this it is evident that the Son of Man is the Divine truth in the Heavens... for no one can ascend into Heaven, unless the Divine truth in him has descended from Heaven... and as the Lord is this truth, He calls Himself the Son of Man who is in the heavens.
The Son of Man hath not where to lay his head (). The Son of Man = the Divine truth, which at that time had no place anywhere, or with any man.
That the Son of Man should suffer, and be killed (illustrated) involves that so it would be done with the Divine truth, consequently with the Lord, who was the Divine truth itself.
As son of man = the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord, the prophets, through whom it was revealed, were called sons of man. Illustrated.
Son of man, in the opposite, = falsity opposite to truth. Illustrated. AE 63:end.
To say a word against the Son of Man () = against the truth Divine not yet implanted or inscribed on the man's life. The Son of Man = the Divine truth.
The Son of Man = the Lord as to Divine truth. AC 10604:4.
The Son of Man, which the Lord called Himself, is not the Son of Mary; but the Divine truth.
To glorify the Son of Man (illustrated) = to make the Human Divine.
The sign of the Son of Man in heaven () = the appearing of the Divine truth. DSS 14:2.
The Son of Man = the Lord as to the Word. DLord 19, General article. DSS 49:2.

Where it treats of Passion, Judgment, Advent, and, in general, of redemption, Salvation, reformation, regeneration, the Lord calls Himself the Son of Man. The reason is that He Himself as to the Word is then understood. DLord 23. DLord 24, illustrated. DLord 25, illustrated. DLord 26, illustrated. DLord 27, illustrated. DLord 27:2, illustrated.

The reason the Son of Man = the Lord as to the Word, was that the prophets also were called sons of man; and the reason the prophets were so called, was that they represented the Lord as to the Word, and thence signified the doctrine of the Church from the Word... for the spiritual signification of prophet, and also of son of man, is the doctrine of the Church from the Word; and, when concerning the Lord, the Word itself. Illustrated.
Blasphemy against the Son of Man = something against the Word, by differently interpreting its meaning; for the Son of Man = the Lord as to the Word.
In the midst of the seven candlesticks one like the Son of Man () = the Lord as to the Word, from whom is the New Church. ( = the Lord from whom is everything of Heaven and of the Church. AE 63.)
As the Lord represented Himself before John as the Word, He who was seen by him is called the Son of Man.
The Son of Man (illustrated) = the Lord as to the Divine Human, and this is the Word, which was God, and was made flesh.
That the Son of Man, who is the Lord as to the Divine Human, is the Almighty, the Alpha and the Omega, etc.
Upon the cloud one sitting like unto the Son of Man () = the Lord as to the Word. Explained. AE 906.

By man is signified intelligence and wisdom from the Word... Hence the prophets were called sons of man, and the Lord Himself called Himself the Son of Man; and the Son of Man is the truth of the Church from the Word; and, while said of the Lord, it is the Word itself from which is the Church.
Nothing but the Divine truth is meant by, Messiah, Son of Man, etc.
The Son of Man = the Lord as to Divine truth. AE 131. AE 297. AE 504:3. AE 750:22. AE 850:9.
The Son of Man = the Lord as to the Divine Human, from which is the Divine truth, which is the all in all of Heaven and the Church.
The Son of Man = the Lord as to the Divine Human, and also as to the Divine truth, because this proceeds from His Divine Human. AE 63:2, Illustrated.
The Son of Man = the Lord as to the Divine Human. AE 113:3. AE 146:2. AE 151.
The angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of Man () = that Divine truths were in Him and from Him.
The Son of Man = the Divine truth proceeding.
The son of man = the doctrine of truth.
Sons of man = those in Divine truths; abstractedly, Divine truths.
Son of man = one intelligent through Divine truth.
Sons of man = those in spiritual truths and goods.
Sons of man = the truths of the Church. AE 455:17. AE 653:5. AE 714:17. AE 750:17.
Sons of man = those in truths from good. AE 458:7. AE 724:26.
Man = man as to wisdom; son of man () = man as to intelligence.
Sons of man = those in Own intelligence.
The Son of Man = the Divine truth, which is the Word. AE 907:2.
Sons of man = those intelligent in Divine truths.
Sons of man () = spiritual truths which are from the Lord through the Word; sons of man = rational and natural truths which are from the understanding; thus the understanding of the Word.

The Son of Man () = Divine truth such as is on earth; thus the Word such as it is in the natural sense. (Thus) to say a word against the Son of Man = to interpret the natural sense of the Word, which is the sense of its letter, according to appearances.
The Son of Man = the Lord as to the Word.
He that soweth the good seed is the Son of Man = Divine truth from the Lord.
The Son of Man = the Lord as to the Divine Human, and as to the Word.
Hence the proceeding Divine is the Lord in the Heavens, and is called the Son of Man, and also the Holy Spirit.

Holy Spirit. 5. 9. The reason why he who speaks a word against the Son of Man is forgiven, is that he [may] deny this or that to be Divine truth from the Word in the Church, provided he believes that in the Word and from the Word are Divine truths. The Son of Man is the Divine truth from the Word in the Church, and this cannot be seen by all.

The Lord called Himself the Son of Man because He was the Word, or Divine truth, even as to His Human; for the title Son of Man, in the spiritual sense, = the truth of the Church derived from the Word. The same was signified by the term prophet... and therefore the Lord, who was the Prophet, and also the Word, and thence Divine truth, called Himself, as to His Human, the Son of Man...
